mapper.sql: id, dataset_id, data_id, class_id, class_attributes,source_id,source_type, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dao.id, dao.dataset_id, dao.data_id, dao.class_id, dao.class_attributes
SELECT DISTINCT dao.id, dao.dataset_id, dao.data_id, dao.class_id, dao.class_attributes

SELECT dao.id, dao.data_id, dao.source_type, JSON_MERGE_PATCH('{}', JSON_OBJECT( 'trackId', dao.class_attributes->'$.trackId', 'type', dao.class_attributes->'$.type',
#{key}, COALESCE( JSON_EXTRACT(dao.class_attributes, CONCAT('$.contour.', #{key})), JSON_EXTRACT(dao.class_attributes, CONCAT('$.meta.', #{key})), JSON_EXTRACT(dao.class_attributes, CONCAT('$.', #{key}))) , 'contour', JSON_OBJECT( 'center3D', dao.class_attributes->'$.contour.center3D', 'size3D', dao.class_attributes->'$.contour.size3D', 'bottomPoints', JSON_EXTRACT(dao.class_attributes, '$.contour.bottomPoints[0]', '$.contour.bottomPoints[1]'), 'topPoints', JSON_EXTRACT(dao.class_attributes, '$.contour.topPoints[0]', '$.contour.topPoints[1]'), 'points', IF(JSON_TYPE(dao.class_attributes->'$.contour.points') = 'ARRAY', JSON_ARRAY(), NULL)) )) AS class_attributes FROM data_annotation_object dao INNER JOIN data d ON d.id = dao.data_id WHERE d.parent_id = #{sceneId} AND d.is_deleted = false AND dao.track_id = #{trackId} ORDER BY dao.id

SELECT dao.id, dao.data_id, dao.class_id, JSON_SET( JSON_MERGE_PATCH('{}', JSON_OBJECT( 'trackId', dao.class_attributes->'$.trackId', 'classId', dao.class_attributes->'$.classId', 'type', dao.class_attributes->'$.type', 'manualSyncSegmentStartDataId', dao.class_attributes->'$.manualSyncSegmentStartDataId', 'contour', JSON_OBJECT( 'center3D', dao.class_attributes->'$.contour.center3D', 'size3D', dao.class_attributes->'$.contour.size3D'))), '$.manualSyncSegmentId', dao.class_attributes->'$.manualSyncSegmentId' ) AS class_attributes FROM data_annotation_object dao INNER JOIN data d ON d.id = dao.data_id WHERE d.parent_id = #{sceneId} AND d.is_deleted = false AND dao.track_id = #{trackId} AND JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(dao.class_attributes, 'one', '$.manualSyncSegmentId') ORDER BY dao.id
